spans.s:
kéśa, m. hair (of the head); mane. [see
kesara.]

keśa-pakṣa, m. du. the two sides of
the hair of the head; the temples.

keśa-śmaśru-loma-nakha, n. pl. hair of
the head, beard, hair of the body, and
nails. [1253a.]

keśānta, m. hair-end; long hair hanging
down; locks.

keśín, a. maned, with flowing mane.
[keśa.]

késara, m. hair; mane. [written also
keśara, cf. keśa: cf. Lat. caesaries, ‘hair,
mane,’ but not Eng. hair.]
kesarāgra, n. ends of a mane. [agra.]
